title: a second setup hook run answers nothing to do, leaves the file byte for byte and makes no backup
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). After the file holds exactly the desired state, a second `jitso setup hook --yes` prints `jitso setup hook: nothing to do (the guard is already registered in .claude/settings.json)`, exit 0, writes nothing and creates no `.jitso/backups`. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.

stdout.regex: ^jitso setup hook: nothing to do \(the guard is already registered in \.claude/settings\.json\)\n$
